members.algorithm: Replace the pure savings-per-distance score with a Clarke-Wright-style savings normalized by a blend of distance-to-current and depot-return distance, so customers that reduce total route length are chosen without the previous scale-sensitive ratio behaviour.

def select_next_node(current_node: int, depot: int, unvisited_nodes: np.ndarray,
                     rest_capacity: float, demands: np.ndarray,
                     distance_matrix: np.ndarray) -> int:
    """Select the next node to visit in a CVRP greedy construction.

    Args:
        current_node:    index of the current node (0 = depot)
        depot:           index of the depot (always 0)
        unvisited_nodes: array of feasible unvisited customer indices
                         (already filtered to satisfy remaining capacity)
        rest_capacity:   remaining vehicle capacity
        demands:         demand of every node (index 0 = depot demand = 0)
        distance_matrix: pairwise Euclidean distance matrix
    Returns:
        Index of the next node to visit, or 0 to return to the depot early.
    """
    if unvisited_nodes.size == 0:
        return depot
    cur = distance_matrix[current_node][unvisited_nodes]
    to_depot = distance_matrix[unvisited_nodes, depot]
    stem = distance_matrix[current_node, depot]
    # Clarke-Wright savings: adding node on the way back saves stem+to_depot-cur
    savings = stem + to_depot - cur
    # Blend of the two reference legs to keep the ratio dimensionally consistent
    denom = 0.5 * (cur + to_depot) + 1e-12
    score = savings / denom
    return int(unvisited_nodes[np.argmax(score)])

members.algorithm: Replace the angular-detour term with a distance-to-depot-progress score that rewards moving radially outward from the depot, keeping the capacity-fill reward and a span-normalized distance term unchanged.

def select_next_node(current_node: int, depot: int, unvisited_nodes: np.ndarray,
                     rest_capacity: float, demands: np.ndarray,
                     distance_matrix: np.ndarray) -> int:
    if unvisited_nodes.size == 0:
        return depot

    if current_node == depot:
        return int(unvisited_nodes[np.argmin(distance_matrix[unvisited_nodes, depot])])

    cur = distance_matrix[current_node][unvisited_nodes]
    to_depot = distance_matrix[unvisited_nodes, depot]
    stem = distance_matrix[current_node, depot]

    # Radial progress: prefer moving outward from depot (span-normalised)
    progress = to_depot - stem
    span = np.max(to_depot) - np.min(to_depot) + 1e-12
    outward = -progress / span  # negative => outward is good (minimised)

    dem = demands[unvisited_nodes]
    fill = dem / (rest_capacity + dem + 1e-12)

    rmax = np.max(cur) + 1e-12
    near = cur / rmax

    score = 0.6 * near + 0.5 * outward - 0.4 * fill
    return int(unvisited_nodes[np.argmin(score)])

members.algorithm: Replace the savings ratio with an additive polar-coordinate score that penalizes the angular detour from the current heading and rewards demand utilization, choosing the customer that best continues the sweep while filling the vehicle.

def select_next_node(current_node: int, depot: int, unvisited_nodes: np.ndarray,
                     rest_capacity: float, demands: np.ndarray,
                     distance_matrix: np.ndarray) -> int:
    """Select the next node to visit in a CVRP greedy construction.

    Args:
        current_node:    index of the current node (0 = depot)
        depot:           index of the depot (always 0)
        unvisited_nodes: array of feasible unvisited customer indices
                         (already filtered to satisfy remaining capacity)
        rest_capacity:   remaining vehicle capacity
        demands:         demand of every node (index 0 = depot demand = 0)
        distance_matrix: pairwise Euclidean distance matrix
    Returns:
        Index of the next node to visit, or 0 to return to the depot early.
    """
    if unvisited_nodes.size == 0:
        return depot

    cur = distance_matrix[current_node][unvisited_nodes]
    to_depot = distance_matrix[unvisited_nodes, depot]
    if current_node == depot:
        # Start with nearest-to-depot sweep: smallest radial distance wins
        return int(unvisited_nodes[np.argmin(to_depot)])

    # Angular detour: use law of cosines with distances only
    stem = distance_matrix[current_node, depot]
    a = stem
    b = to_depot
    c = cur
    denom = 2.0 * np.sqrt(np.maximum(a * b, 1e-12))
    cos_theta = np.clip((a * a + b * b - c * c) / denom, -1.0, 1.0)
    # Detour grows with (1 - cos_theta); prefer continuing the sweep
    detour = 1.0 - cos_theta
    # Reward filling the vehicle: prefer high demand relative to remaining capacity
    dem = demands[unvisited_nodes]
    fill = dem / (rest_capacity + dem + 1e-12)
    # Normalize radial distance by max in candidate set to keep scale-free
    rmax = np.max(b) + 1e-12
    radial = b / rmax

    score = 0.7 * detour + 0.6 * radial - 0.4 * fill
    return int(unvisited_nodes[np.argmin(score)])
